message: 含まれるもの。含まれないもの
On the table before us sit traditional Japanese sweets, each plated individually on expensive-looking dishes

name: Misasagi
message: 「Take a nice shot for me, won't you?」
With Senior Misasagi and several members of the Wagashi Club watching on, Azel raised the digital camera without a hint of nervousness.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Would you mind if I took a look?」
When Azel handed over the digital camera, Senior Misasagi peered into the monitor--

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why, how lovely.」
It seemed the photo of the sweet hadn't turned out half bad.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on a second! Azel, don't fall for it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?!」

name: Azel
message: 「Am I being deceived?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes, you are. Speaking from bitter experience, this bubuzuke bastard isn't satisfied with your photo at all!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh, dear me. Here I was taking such care to steer things smoothly without making waves, and you've gone and ruined it. How mean of you.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When this girl says 'lovely,' it doesn't mean 'good' like it does for the rest of us! There's an invisible 'couldn't care less' attached to it! It means she doesn't give a damn.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that true?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, it can't be helped, I suppose. For my part, I figured putting it into words wouldn't get through to you, so I was hoping to show you another way.」

name: Azel
message: 「There is a method that does not use words?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「By your way of putting it, I suppose you'd call it illogical.」
Senior Misasagi held out a plate with a disc-shaped sweet toward Azel

name: Misasagi
message: 「Please, do enjoy.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is this something you couldn't care less about?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You'll understand once you have a bite.」
Azel obediently reached out, picked up the sweet, and took a bite.
A face so stern it could almost seem cold softened into a faint smile.

name: Azel
message: 「...It's delicious.」
I wonder why.
Lately, I feel like there are more and more moments where I think Azel is kind of cute.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sweets are way more delicious!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I do like you, you know. However, a child who cannot read the room is simply boorish, wouldn't you say?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mgh. More importantly, don't say you like me! It gives me goosebumps!」
After quietly finishing her meal, Azel looked at her own photo once more.

name: Azel
message: 「...It doesn't look delicious.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That is precisely it. Now then, please do enjoy the rest of the sweets as well.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll take them.」
So that's how it is.
Azel had simply photographed the sweets the same way she would photograph a roadside pebble or a building.
Is that why something was missing from the photo too?

name: Misasagi
message: 「Are they delicious?」

name: Azel
message: 「All of them were delicious.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Aaaaah! You're eating Pasta's sweets, nya--!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I figured you would be barging in right about now, so I have prepared a portion for you as well.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ooh! You're the absolute best human ever, nya!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A waitress mooching sweets off customers... Normally, she'd be fired.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if word hasn't reached Helena-san...?」
Considering who she is, that seems unlikely, though.

name: Pasta
message: 「Ahh, it's yummy, nya! So yummy, nya!」
Azel aimed her camera at the Waitress.

name: Pasta
message: 「Looking forward to the next one too, nya! Looking forward to this is the whole reason I work, nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Work? Don't you mean rampage?」

name: Synn
message: 「No comment from me.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Fuho. It's yummy, nya! My cheeks are gonna fall off, nya! Humans-the food here is yummy, nya!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The way she's acting... doesn't it remind you of someone?」

name: Synn
message: 「Indeed.」
Sally and the Waitress look alike.

name: Pasta
message: 「W-Why are you taking a picture of Pasta, nya!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you mind?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I don't want pictures taken of me slacking off from work and stuffing my face, nya! You're planning to blackmail me with it, nya!」

name: Azel
message: 「I took it because you had a good expression.」

name: Pasta
message: 「P-Pasta had a good expression, nya?」

name: Azel
message: 「Lively, and overflowing with the joy of being alive.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Am I being complimented, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. She means you've got a great look on your face.」

name: Pasta
message: 「I-Is that so, nya? Turns out you're a pretty good person too, nya.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Pasta-han.」

name: Pasta
message: 「What is it, you absolute angel of a human? Gonna give me another one, nya?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The lady from the kitchen is glaring daggers over here.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaaaaa! I'm gonna get punished again-again-again-again, nyaaa! Not the Cliffside Agony Chili Pepper Special, nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-She got caught right away.」
God help her.

name: Pasta
message: 「Don't take a picture, nyaaaaaaaaa!」
